name: Araj Oblodra
appearance: While Araj does at first feign the part of a studious researcher and alchemist, the grey-skinned, red-eyed drow has no qualms with deception, torture, murder, and even genocide.
backstory:
Araj Oblodra is a daughter of the now-defunct . Over a century ago, an alliance of rival drow in the city of destroyed her House, due to their association with psionics and mind flayers before and during the , among many other crimes.

Few survived the House's destruction and, as Araj believes herself to be the last remaining daughter of Oblodra, she yearns to reinstate the House to its former glory.
